861:t_144:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Great work, everyone. Take your time and get some rest.」

861:t_144:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Where do you think you're going? You have remedial lessons waiting after this.」

861:t_144:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Once the game has refreshed you, everyone, do your best at your studies or your jobs too.」

861:t_145:4.en:
$n
「I'm sorry. I let you see me in an embarrassing state.」

861:t_145:5.en:
$n
「As you can see, I'm still fighting fear inside my heart.」

861:t_145:6.en:
$n
「But my greatest fear is that if the game stays paused, my volunteer spirit will grow rusty.」

861:t_145:7.en:
$n
「That's why I'm waiting for you to return. Let's pick up litter together again.」

861:t_146:3.en:
$n
「Good work, players. I'll step away from the game too and enjoy some time on my hobby.」

861:t_146:4.en:
$n
「Why don't you join me, if you'd like? Picking up litter in the sunshine is the best!」

861:t_146:5.en:
$n
「...Joking aside, I recommend moving your body after a long gaming session.」

861:t_146:6.en:
$n
「Well, I'm going to pick up litter. See you again!」

861:t_147:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Good work. What are you planning to do now?」

861:t_147:4.en:
$n
「I was thinking of picking up some litter...」

861:t_147:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That sounds good. As your club advisor, I'll join you.」

861:t_147:6.en:
$n
「Then I'll go invite everyone else too.」

861:t_147:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Stop! ...I'd like it to be just the two of us today...」

861:t_147:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So, players, please turn a blind eye for a little while too.」

861:t_148:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What, you're done already? You're pathetic.」

861:t_148:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Show me enough enthusiasm to clear this game without resetting or stopping!」

861:t_148:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Hehe... I expect great things from you. So come back soon.」

861:t_148:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then I'll play with you, just for you.」

861:t_149:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If you're taking a break, this is a good opportunity. Let's have the player decide which of us to choose.」

861:t_149:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If you choose me, I'll give you plenty of service you could never expect from a stuffy schoolteacher.」

861:t_149:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then you'd better think of some service you can offer too.」

861:t_149:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So there you have it. Decide which of us you'll choose before you resume the game.」

861:t_149:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I have faith in you, player!」

861:t_150:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Good work, players. Take your time and get some rest.」

861:t_150:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm a little tired too, so I think I'll eat something sweet and take a break.」

861:t_150:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Did you know? Chocolate goes well with beer.」

861:t_150:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'll be careful not to drink too much and end up sad. Well, everyone... See you again.」

861:t_151:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「When I think about it, we've come a long way.」

861:t_151:4.en:
$$メール$$
「But $$ビーター・サービス$$' journey will be over soon too...」

861:t_151:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Getting all gloomy doesn't suit us, $$メール$$!」

861:t_151:6.en:
$$メール$$
「OK, darling! We'll keep smiling and doing our best right to the end!」

861:t_151:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's the spirit, players! Lend us your strength right to the very end!」

861:t_151:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's get fired up! Let's get as fired up as we can!」

861:t_152:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「I never thought I'd end up appearing here with you like this.」

861:t_152:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You're right. We should be grateful the 'Super Robot Wars Z' series kept going.」

861:t_152:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「Everything comes to an end... I'd like to say that, but your debts are eternal.」

861:t_152:7.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'm counting on you players too. Clear the game quickly so $$クロウ$$ can focus on paying off his debts.」

861:t_152:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「See you. I'll be expecting great things from you.」

861:t_153:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「The day has finally come when we can greet all the players here too.」

861:t_153:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's been a year of hardship since 'Jigoku-hen'...! I've been longing for this day!」

861:t_153:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「If we're talking about that, I've waited four years since 'Hakai-hen'.」

861:t_153:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's pour all those feelings into this!」

861:t_153:7.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'm counting on you, everyone. Master 'D Commands' and seize victory!」

861:t_153:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, let's give it our all today too...!」

861:t_153:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah! Being fully voiced is the best!」

861:t_154:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Well, now that the game is paused, let's discuss his training plan from here on.」

861:t_154:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「First, you need to smile! Aim to stop being the quiet type!」

861:t_154:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Next, you need charm! Do your best to stop being the quiet type!」
